instructions: Copy simulation.json to a NEW measured_config.json, replace every measured parameter using the guide, and add the hardware object below. This file alone is intentionally not runnable.
speed_table_schema: ascending [measured speed m/s, PWM command 0..100] pairs, >=3 points covering min_speed through max_speed
steering_table_schema: ascending [measured road-wheel angle deg, servo command deg] pairs, >=3 points covering +/-max_steer_deg; servo commands within [45, 135] (Front_Wheels.turn clamp), lower = left
picar_database_schema: ABSOLUTE path to the calibrated SunFounder config (turning_offset, forward_A, forward_B). Keep a comment line after the last key: picar.filedb never reads the last line
turning_offset_at_calibration_schema: turning_offset value in that file when the steering table was measured; motion is refused if it changes
evidence_files_schema: paths to captured calibration results and commissioning records, resolved from the repo root
